# Basecart E-commerce Platform Architecture & AI Documentation (`llms.txt`)

Basecart is a production-ready, ultra-fast, multi-tenant headless e-commerce SaaS platform built for high scale, reliability, and security.

> Platform Web Host: https://basecart.app  
> API Base URL: https://api.basecart.app  
> Merchant Console: https://merchant.basecart.app  

---

## 1. System Architecture

- **Frontend Core**: Next.js 14+ App Router, React 18, TailwindCSS, TypeScript.
- **Backend Core**: Cloudflare Workers / Hono framework (`packages/backend`).
- **Database Layer**: Multi-tenant database routing using Cloudflare D1 (SQLite) and Durable Objects (`TenantDO`).
- **Storage**: AWS S3 / Cloudflare R2 for product media assets with edge optimization (`getOptimizedImageUrl`).
- **Payment Processing**: Razorpay API integration with HMAC-SHA256 signature verification and order creation flows.
- **Logistics**: Shiprocket courier API integration for automated AWB tracking & shipping labels.

---

## 2. Key Web Applications & Routes

### Merchant Dashboard (`packages/merchant-dashboard`)
- `/login` & `/signup`: Merchant onboarding with 60-day free trial auto-assignment.
- `/store/[subdomain]`: Main operational console (Analytics, Orders, Catalog, Customers).
- `/store/[subdomain]/settings/plan`: Subscription tier management & Razorpay checkout (Starter ₹299, Growth ₹699, Pro ₹1,499, Agency ₹4,999).
- `/store/[subdomain]/settings/team`: Staff & Permissions access control matrix (`owner`, `admin`, `fulfillment`, `support`).
- `/store/[subdomain]/settings/notifications`: Transactional email templates (Order Shipped, Confirmation) via ZeptoMail.

### Customer Storefront (`packages/storefront`)
- `/store/[subdomain]`: Dynamic storefront homepage rendered via customizable theme engine (Minimalist, Cyber, Modern, Elegant).
- `/store/[subdomain]/products/[slug]`: Product details page with variant selectors, live inventory badges, interactive customer reviews, and JSON-LD schema markup.
- `/store/[subdomain]/cart`: Slide-out shopping cart drawer with live subtotal, shipping progress bar, and coupon application.
- `/store/[subdomain]/checkout`: Seamless Razorpay Web Checkout integration with IGST tax breakdown.

---

## 3. SEO, Metadata & Search Engine Guidelines

- **Canonical URLs**: All public store pages auto-generate dynamic `<link rel="canonical">` tags based on host header.
- **Structured Data (JSON-LD)**: Product detail pages include Schema.org `Product`, `Offer`, and `AggregateRating` microdata.
- **OpenGraph & Twitter Cards**: Dynamic social preview tags (`og:title`, `og:description`, `og:image`, `og:type`) embedded on every route.
- **Robots Directives**: Storefront allows search crawlers (`/robots.txt`), pointing directly to `/sitemap.xml`. Admin dashboard explicitly blocks indexing (`noindex, nofollow`).

---

## 4. API & Integration Reference

- `POST /auth/merchant/signup`: Registers merchant tenant & provisions isolated database schema.
- `POST /api/create-order`: Generates Razorpay server-side `order_id` for secure checkout.
- `POST /api/verify-payment`: Validates Razorpay HMAC-SHA256 signature and marks orders paid.
- `GET /store/staff` & `POST /store/staff/invite`: Manages team staff accounts and RBAC permissions.
